verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe a versioned /v1 API with an X-API-Version header and a dated changelog that announces breaking changes before they ship. The legacy migration guide also promises per-account notice periods, during which legacy requests keep working. The deprecation commitment has weakened: the FAQ's guaranteed deprecation-window sentence was removed, and callers cannot pin a version. missing for 10: a fixed, guaranteed minimum deprecation window; caller-selectable version pinning; independent or hands-on corroboration of how deprecations are actually handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Breaking changes are announced here before they ship.
If you received a deprecation notice, use the retirement date in that message as the cutoff for your account. Legacy requests will continue to work during the notice period.
It reports the version that answered; you cannot send it to choose a version
